author: PokerFace
body:
Hello, I made a post earlier but I have decided to make 2 seperate posts.

Red Alert Map-Clarity

Picture Links- http://imgur.com/a/Gea3y
Map File-
https://www.mediafire.com/folder/grc6m921ii67e/SkyBlock1.0
This map shouldn't contribute to lower fps. It is in my opinion the perfect size for a 8-16 player red alert game.

-I worked really hard on this and I hope you guys like this map. I made everything without world edit.
-Feedback is appreciated.
-I do not know how to the yaml thing so if you guys could do that, that would be awesome.
